linkedin:4489537689.description:
Baví tě vývoj webů, backend v PHP a nezalekneš se ani občasné úpravy CSS nebo převzetí odpovědnosti za celý projekt?

Do našeho týmu v menší webové agentuře hledáme alespoň mediorního PHP / full-stack vývojáře, který má minimálně 3 roky praxe s PHP a alespoň 1 rok zkušeností se Symfony frameworkem.

Pracovat můžeš ideálně z našeho kanclu na jihu Čech nebo na částečný remote (po „zajetí“). Spolupráci si nastavíme podle domluvy — na plný nebo částečný úvazek. Ideálně hledáme člověka na ŽL, při on-site spolupráci je možný i HPP.

Tech stack

Pracoval Bys s

Primárně

  • Symfony 7.4+
  • MySQL/MariaDB 8
  • Ecommerce platforma Sylius
  • Twig
  • Lokální stack DDEV

Dle tvých schopností

  • JS
  • CSS/SASS (Tailwind 3+, Foundation)
  • DevOps (Gitlab CI/CD, Deployer, Docker)
  • Flutter
  • Elastic, MeiliSearch
  • Kirby CMS
  • Nette (migrujeme na Symfony)

Vůbec nevadí, jestli nemáš se všemi těmito technologiemi zkušenosti. Důležitá je znalost principů SW vývoje a chuť se učit.

Chceme od tebe

  • Dodávat funkční nasaditelné řešení. Zdá se jako samozřejmost, ale vyžaduje to určitou důslednost nebo TDD přístup.
  • Orientaci v existující codebase a přibližně se držet konvence projektu. Pracujeme primárně na dlouhodobých projektech. Cílem je tedy udržitelnost vývoje, postupné snižování případného technického dluhu při dodávání nových featur a s tím nutný refactoring. Jestli jsi vyhraněný na 1 technologii, kterou chceš stavět na zelené louce, agentura asi není pro tebe.
  • Chuť učit se i mimo čisté PHP. Jsme malý 12členný tým s větším množstvím projektů, takže ti budeme zadávat úkoly od návrhu databáze až po vývoj, otestování a nasazení. Tu a tam se bude hodit i základní cit pro UX, ale neboj, kolegové ti rádi pomůžou, poradí a nasměrují.
  • Znalost angličtiny. Číst anglické články a dokumentace je základ vzdělávání programátora, psaní kódu v angličtině (proměnné, komentáře) považujeme dnes už za standard.
  • Komunikace a dotahování. Některé projekty budou (po tvém zajetí) na tvé přímé odpovědnosti, resp. ty budeš aplikaci také nasazovat. Je tedy potřeba, abys byl ochoten se ptát při jakkoli nejasném zadání nebo technickém problému. Všichni ve firmě ti rádi odpovíme a pomůžeme.

Bonusové body

  • Kvalita tvého kódu.
  • Kvalita časových odhadů a spolehlivost v plnění termínů.
  • DevOps zkušenostmi – správa linux serveru, Gitlab CI, Docker, performance tuning.
  • Přesahem do frontend developmentu a základním citem pro UX.
  • Schopností hledat kreativní řešení a zaměřit se na byznys cíle klienta.

Proč pracovat v Net Magnetu?

  • 🙋‍♂️ Příjemné pracovní prostředí v Českém Krumlově v partě sympatických lidí. U nás můžeš chodit klidně v teplákách. Jezdíme na teambuildingy a občas po práci vyrazíme do přírody nebo na firemní pivo, když má někdo narozeniny 🥳 Ale rádi navážeme spolupráci i na částečný remote, pokud budeš ochoten v prvním měsíci spolupráce jezdit do kanceláře.
  • 🍝 Oběd dle výběru zdarma a občerstvení. Každý den máme závoz obědů dle výběru a po jídle si můžeš nakopnout kvalitním espressem nebo osvěžujícím frappé a zakousnout k tomu pochutiny sladké i zdravé 🙂
  • 🤑 Odpovídající ohodnocení závislé na tvém výkonu a zkušenostech. Poloviční nebo plný úvazek není problém. Nástupní plat full time mediora cca 50 000 až 80 000 Kč, v případě seniora až okolo 100 000 Kč na ŽL nebo tomu odpovídající mzda.
  • 🦉 Profesní růst. Snažíme se dělat svou práci nejlépe, jak umíme, a rádi tě to naučíme. Vzděláváme se a všichni se vzájemně učíme. Úměrně ke tvým schopnostem bude růst ohodnocení práce, kterou ti zadáme.
  • 🏄Flexibilní pracovní doba. Potřebuješ něco akutně vyřídit, onemocněli ti děti, nebo si jen chceš si dát den volna? Když nám to oznámíš a zapíšeš do kalendáře, je to úplně v pohodě. Chceme ale přítomnost na standupech 3x týdně a dostupnost na Slacku v pracovní dny v 9-15 h.
  • 🎨 Práce na různorodých projektech. Mezi naše klienty patří malé firmy, jedničky na trhu ve svých oborech i firmy ze zahraničí. Nudit se nebudeš!
  • 📈 Jsme na vzestupu. Daří se nám získávat zajímavější zakázky, máme vlastní SaaS produkt VezuMenu.cz a zkrátka rosteme. Naskočíš do našeho rozjetého vlaku?

Co teď musíš udělat

Poslat nám ukázky svých prací, na které jsi pyšný(á) na info@netmagnet.cz. Pověz nám také, co by tě nejvíc bavilo. Klidně přilož své CV, může ti jedině pomoci. Těšíme se na tebe!

linkedin:4479964207.title: Senior Network Engineer
linkedin:4479964207.description:
About the Role

Own the operation, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance of Masan's core network across our corporate office, selected Data Center domains and multi-cloud environments.

Beyond day-to-day multi-vendor operations, you will support IT teams across Masan's member companies with L2/L3 escalations, run periodic Network & Firewall Audits, and provide technical advisory to standardize network infrastructure across the Group.


What You'll Do

  • Operate, configure and maintain the office network and assigned Data Center domains (Core/Spine-Leaf switching, vPC/Stacking, Load Balancers), plus WAN and SD-WAN.
  • Manage the enterprise wireless estate (Access Points, Wireless Controllers): RF optimization, roaming, QoS, DHCP/DNS and 802.1X/NAC authentication.
  • Run multi-vendor firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco) and their management platforms (Panorama, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer): policy and NAT changes, IPsec/SSL VPN, IDS/IPS and network segmentation.
  • Build and maintain Hybrid/Multi-Cloud connectivity across Azure, AWS and GCP (ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, VPN Gateway, VNet/VPC routing, Transit Gateway, Load Balancer).
  • Support member-company IT teams with network operations and L2/L3 escalations; conduct periodic network/firewall configuration audits and recommend infrastructure optimizations.
  • Monitor availability, capacity and performance via NMS tools (Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds, SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow) to meet SLAs on uptime, latency and bandwidth.
  • Analyze logs and packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to resolve complex incidents and author Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for major events.
  • Coordinate with ISPs on circuit quality and SLAs, and with vendors (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Huawei, Juniper) on TAC cases and hardware RMA.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance: config backups, health checks, firmware/OS upgrades and CVE patching under Change Management.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation (network diagrams, IPAM/NetBox, standard configs, SOPs/runbooks) and automate repetitive tasks with Ansible, Terraform and Python.
  • Join UAT, cutover and operational handover for new infrastructure and cloud migrations.


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics & Telecommunications or a related field.
  • Experience: 3–5 years (Network Engineer) or 5+ years (Senior Network Engineer) in enterprise network operations across office, multi-branch, Data Center or Cloud environments.
  • Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting of multi-vendor firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Cisco Firepower; Panorama, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer), switches/routers (Cisco Catalyst/Nexus, FortiSwitch, Huawei, Juniper) and wireless (Cisco WLC/Meraki, FortiAP, Aruba).
  • Solid command of routing, switching and network security protocols: BGP, OSPF, VXLAN, VRF, VLAN, STP, LACP, StackWise, vPC/VSS, QoS, 802.1X/RADIUS, IPsec/SSL VPN, NAC.
  • Experience operating SD-WAN (Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Viptela/Meraki, VeloCloud) and Hybrid Cloud networking on Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Proficiency with monitoring tools (Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds), IPAM (NetBox) and packet analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump); network/firewall audit experience.
  • Strong ownership and operational discipline in Production, with strict adherence to Change Management.
  • Strong communication and consulting skills to work with member-company IT teams, infrastructure teams and partners.
  • Willingness to be on-call for critical incidents and maintenance windows.


Nice to Have

  • Network automation experience (Ansible, Terraform, Python).
  • Certifications: CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE 4–7, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, or Cloud Networking certifications.
  • Curiosity for emerging approaches such as SASE, Zero Trust and Network-as-Code.


Why Join Masan

  • Operate network infrastructure at Group scale, spanning multiple businesses, Data Centers and three major clouds.
  • Influence standards across member companies, not just one environment.
  • Work with enterprise-grade multi-vendor technology and grow toward architecture and automation.

You will own the growth of one Autonomous product — Lamp, Harness or Autonomous Computer — sold to customers in the US. You set up and run the campaigns yourself, use AI every day to move faster, and report to the CEO.


This role fits you if you have already grown a product for US or international customers (app, SaaS, Shopify/Amazon brand, consumer electronics) and can show the numbers. If your experience is mainly the Vietnamese market or a single channel, this is not the right role.


Who we are

Autonomous is a US AI-hardware company, designed and built in Saigon. We have offices in New York, San Francisco and Saigon. Today we build hardware for the AI era: computers that run AI, an open-source operating system, and devices for people who work with AI agents. Most of our customers are in the US.


The role

We're hiring 3 Product Growth Leads, one for each product. You own your product's growth in the US market and do the work yourself. This is a hands-on role, not a people-management one.


The three products

Tell us which one you want to own.


  • Harness. An app and desk device that lets developers control all their AI coding agents in one place. Goal for your first 90 days: build the path from free app user to device buyer and grow the number of app users who buy the device every month.


  • Lamp. A desk robot that sees, moves, talks, and runs the AI agent its owner chooses. Buyers: tech fans, makers, developers. Goal for your first 90 days: build demand before launch, measured in waitlist sign-ups, pre-orders and the number of creators making content about Lamp.


  • Autonomous Computer. GPU machines for teams that run AI on their own hardware instead of the cloud. Goal for your first 90 days: publish benchmarks and case studies that earn trust for a large B2B purchase, and send a steady flow of qualified leads to sales every month.


What you'll do

  • Own your product's growth in the US across channels: paid ads, content, social, email, KOLs and community. You set the plan, the budget split and run it yourself.
  • Test something new every week, keep what works, and track the funnel from first visit to order.
  • Make English content for US buyers: posts, videos, landing pages, emails.
  • Use AI tools every day to work faster; turn repeated work into AI workflows where it helps.
  • Report your numbers every week against your 90-day goal.


What you bring

  • 3+ years in growth or product growth, building and running campaigns yourself.
  • You've owned the growth of a real product sold to US or international customers — across several channels, with numbers to show.
  • You know how US buyers find and buy tech: channels, ad costs, what earns their trust.
  • Hands-on: you set up the campaigns, make the content, run the tests and read the numbers yourself.
  • You use AI in your daily work and can show us how.
  • Strong written and spoken English. You write for US customers.


Nice to have

  • You've built AI agents or workflows that run real parts of your marketing.
  • You've launched a product on Kickstarter, Product Hunt or Amazon.
  • Hardware, consumer electronics or B2B tech experience.


How you'll work

You work on-site at our office in Phú Nhuận, Saigon, during Vietnam hours.

Around product launches and big social posts you may also work some US hours. You report to our CEO, who approves your ad budget and reviews your results with you every week. Our Marketing Lead advises on brands and channels. You work with your product's engineers, and the 3 Product Growth Leads share what works across products.

  • Unlimited sick leave, official holidays, and at least 12 paid days off annually.
  • MacBook, monitor, standing desk, and the tools you need to do your best work.

Send your CV, one product you grew for US or international customers (with numbers), and one example of how you use AI in your work (a screenshots). Tell us which product you want to own.

  • Execution & Integration: Supervise the development process, support continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), and monitor system performance.
  • Validation & Quality Control: Lead architectural reviews, enforce continuous testing strategies, and validate non-functional system criteria.
  • Architecture Management: Build and maintain technical roadmaps, address technical risks, manage the technical backlog, and guide and mentor engineering teams.

  • Full-Stack Development Skills: Strong hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js/NestJS and frontend development using React/Next.js.
  • Language Proficiency: Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experience: 3–5 years in a similar role as a Technical Architect.
  • Cloud Expertise: Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (preferably Google Cloud), with advanced skills in Kubernetes, Service Mesh, and building scalable, secure systems.
  • Application Architecture: Proficient in designing and evaluating software systems using approaches like Microservices, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Clean Architecture.
  • Data Architecture: Expertise in designing scalable data models and managing relational and non-relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), ensuring performance and scalability.
  • Non-Functional Requirements: Demonstrated ability to manage system performance, security, and scalability.
  • Troubleshooting Skills: Strong analytical skills to effectively diagnose and resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Communication: Able to clearly explain complex technical matters to both technical and business audiences.

Personal Qualities

  • Proven experience in coaching and mentoring team members.
  • Maintains composure and effectiveness while addressing challenges or solving problems.

Job Description:

Individual will be responsible for managing the hardware development of SOC/MCU from concept to mass production. During the life cycle of the project, he would be responsible for -


Responsibilities:

  • Solid technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in of HW Chip development (CPU’s/GPU’s/MCU’s/SoC’s/Memory dev etc.)
  • Able to plan and manage complex Projects spanning across multiple departments and different development phases (from concept to production).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including design, verification, software, and manufacturing to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, and track progress against milestones.
  • Ensure & manage project KPIs.
  • Identify the opportunities to improve productivity & development efficiency.
  • Should be able to upfront Identify & mitigate the risks.
  • Managing timely and clear communication upwards & within the team.
  • Communicate project status, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders, including senior management and customers.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes and methodologies.
  • Sharing the best practices with other project managers.
  • Mentor and guide junior project managers and team members.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in hardware project management, with a focus on SoC/MCU development.
  • Able to communicate in both Japanese & English
  • Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex hardware projects.
  • Strong understanding of MCU/SoC architecture, design, and verification processes.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • PMP or similar project management certification is a plus.
